arxiv-2103-14090.title: Taming Fluctuations for Gaussian States in Loop Quantum Cosmology
arxiv-2103-14090.creator: Patrick Fraser
arxiv-2103-14090.description: Abstract We do not observe quantum effects on cosmological scales. Thus, if loop quantum cosmology (LQC) is to provide an accurate depiction of the real world, it must allow for quantum states of spacetime geometry which are semi-classical in two respects: they must be sharply peaked around a single, classical geometry, and they must have small quantum fluctuations.

arxiv-2104-04081.title: Merit functions and measurement schemes for single parameter depolarization models Journal: oe Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2104-04081.creator: Lisa Li \authormark 1 and Meredith Kupinski \authormark 1
arxiv-2104-04081.description: Abstract Mueller polarized bi-directional scattering distribution functions (pBSDFs) are 4 × 4 4\times 4 matrix-valued functions which depend on acquisition geometry. The most popular pBSDF is a weighted sum between a Fresnel matrix and an ideal depolarizer. This work’s main contribution is relating the relative weight between an ideal depolarizer and Fresnel matrix to a single depolarization parameter.

arxiv-2302-00467.title: Review on Quantum Computing for Lattice Field Theory
arxiv-2302-00467.creator: Stefan Kühn
arxiv-2302-00467.description: Abstract In these proceedings, we review recent advances in applying quantum computing to lattice field theory. Quantum computing offers the prospect to simulate lattice field theories in parameter regimes that are largely inaccessible with the conventional Monte Carlo approach, such as the sign-problem afflicted regimes of finite baryon density, topological terms, and out-of-equilibrium dynamics.

arxiv-2311-09473.title: JAB: Joint Adversarial Prompting and Belief Augmentation
arxiv-2311-09473.creator: Ninareh Mehrabi, Palash Goyal, Anil Ramakrishna, Jwala Dhamala, Shalini Ghosh, Richard Zemel, Kai-Wei Chang, Aram Galstyan, Rahul Gupta
arxiv-2311-09473.description: Abstract With the recent surge of language models in different applications, attention to safety and robustness of these models has gained significant importance. Here we introduce a joint framework in which we simultaneously probe and improve the robustness of a black-box target model via adversarial prompting and belief augmentation using iterative feedback loops.

arxiv-2406-12885.title: neuSIM4: A comprehensive GEANT4 based neutron simulation code
arxiv-2406-12885.creator: J. Park, F. C. E. Teh, M. B. Tsang, K. W. Brown, Z. Chajecki, B. Hong, T. Lokotko, W. G. Lynch, J. Wieske, K. Zhu
arxiv-2406-12885.description: Abstract A new neu tron SIM ulation program based on the versatile GEANT 4 toolkit, neuSIM4 , has been developed to describe interactions of neutrons in the NE213 liquid scintillator from 0.1 to 3000 MeV. neuSIM4 is designed to accommodate complicated modern detector geometry setups with multiple scintillator detectors, each of which can be outfitted with more than one photo-multiplier.

arxiv-2410-07877.title: Constrained Skill Discovery: Quadruped Locomotion with Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2410-07877.creator: Vassil Atanassov, Wanming Yu, Alexander Luis Mitchell, Mark Nicholas Finean, Ioannis Havoutis
arxiv-2410-07877.description: Abstract Representation learning and unsupervised skill discovery can allow robots to acquire diverse and reusable behaviors without the need for task-specific rewards. In this work, we use unsupervised reinforcement learning to learn a latent representation by maximizing the mutual information between skills and states subject to a distance constraint.

arxiv-2501-10535.title: LEAD TIMES IN FLUX: ANALYZING AIRBNB BOOKING DYNAMICS DURING GLOBAL UPHEAVALS (2018-2022)
arxiv-2501-10535.creator: Harrison Katz, Erica Savage, Peter Coles
arxiv-2501-10535.description: Abstract Short-term changes in booking behaviors can significantly undermine naive forecasting methods in the travel and hospitality industry, especially during periods of global upheaval. Traditional metrics like average or median lead times capture only broad trends, often missing subtle yet impactful distributional shifts.

arxiv-2512-10122.title: Numerical approximation of the first p p -Laplace eigenpair
arxiv-2512-10122.creator: Hannah Potgieter, Razvan C. Fetecau, Steven J. Ruuth
arxiv-2512-10122.description: Abstract We approximate the first Dirichlet eigenpair of the p p -Laplace operator for 2 ≤ p < ∞ 2\leq p<\infty on both Euclidean and surface domains. We emphasize large p p values and discuss how the p → ∞ p\to\infty limit connects to the underlying geometry of our domain. Working with large p p values introduces significant numerical challenges.

arxiv-2512-19846.title: A Class of Axis–Angle Attitude Control Laws for Rotational Systems
arxiv-2512-19846.creator: Francisco M. F. R. Gonçalves, Ryan M. Bena, Néstor O. Pérez-Arancibia
arxiv-2512-19846.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Francisco M. F. R. Gonçalves, Ryan M. Bena, Néstor O. Pérez-Arancibia. We introduce a new class of attitude control laws for rotational systems, which generalizes the use of the Euler axis–angle representation beyond quaternion-based formulations. Using basic Lyapunov’s stability theory and the notion of extended 𝒦 ∞ \mathcal{K}_{\infty} functions, we developed a method for determining and enforcing the global asymptotic stability of the single fixed point of the resulting closed-loop (CL) scheme.

pmc-11397224.title: Evaluation of Shape Recovery Performance of Shape Memory Polymers with Carbon-Based Fillers
pmc-11397224.creator: Sungwoong Choi, Seongeun Jang, Seung Hwa Yoo, Gyo Woo Lee, Duyoung Choi, Wei Min Huang
pmc-11397224.description: This study focuses on enhancing the thermal properties and shape recovery performance of shape memory polymers (SMPs) through the application of carbon-based fillers. Single and mixed fillers were used to investigate their effects on the glass transition temperature (Tg), thermal conductivity, and shape recovery performance.

pmc-13649815.title: Standard TAPP with flat mesh versus TAPP with flat mesh plus mesh plug for inguinal hernia repair: a preliminary single-center randomized experience
pmc-13649815.creator: Morteza Azadbakht, Mohammadali Hassanvand
pmc-13649815.description: BackgroundInguinal hernia repair is a common surgical procedure. While laparoscopic transabdominal preperitoneal (TAPP) repair is widely adopted, the comparative efficacy of standard flat mesh alone versus flat mesh plus mesh plug augmentation remains an area of ongoing clinical evaluation. This study aimed to compare these two techniques with respect to recurrence, postoperative pain, and patient recovery.

pmc-13670503.title: Incidence and prevalence of interstitial lung diseases in Norway: analysis of the national Norwegian patient registry
pmc-13670503.creator: Michael T Durheim, Phuong Phuong Diep, Sandre S Lirhus, Tomas M L Eagan
pmc-13670503.description: BackgroundInterstitial lung diseases (ILDs) are progressive chronic lung diseases associated with poor prognosis despite available disease-modifying therapy. Reported incidence and prevalence of ILD varies, and few studies have described epidemiology across the range of ILD subtypes in complete population-based cohorts.
